title: Japanese Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired stir fry made with chicken, noodles, and warm, spicy Thai-inspired flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the noodles to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they begin to soften.
Add the soy sauce, honey, and ginger to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the chicken is coated in the sauce.
Serve the chicken and noodles hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
Optional: serve with additional soy sauce, honey, or Thai red curry paste on the side for added flavor.
